newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weaker, naphtha strengthen.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weaker, naphtha strengthen.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline failed to recover losses of $2.00 to $3.00 a tonne made in the wake of bearish U.S. stocks data.
Naphtha was firmer with a trading house bidding aggressively for a pipeline spec cargo at $184 a tonne cif NWE.
Gas oil prices were weaker. In the key ARA market brokers said supportive buying interest from one major was less evident.
However, German inland traders said thin buying interest was fuelling strong competition for business and weaker ARA markets were allowing importers to remained competitive.
